title: Opentrons COVID-19 Testing Protocol Using Zymo Kit
author: Max Marrone
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bezzjf76
materials: BP Genomics internal extraction control RNA

steps.title: Clean the OT-2
steps.instruction: Clean the OT-2 COVID-19 Diagnostic Station.

steps.title: Prepare Reagent Tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare the Proteinase K and internal extraction control RNA in 1.5 mL snap cap tubes and place them in the Opentrons 24 tube rack.

substeps.instruction: Pipette Proteinase K (prepared from the Zymo Quick-DNA/RNA Viral MagBead kit) into a 1.5 mL snap cap tube; volume depends on sample count.
Place the Proteinase K tube in well D1 of the reagent tube rack.
Pipette internal extraction control RNA (prepared from the BP Genomics 2019-nCov Detection Assay kit) into a 1.5 mL snap cap tube; volume depends on sample count.
Place the internal extraction control RNA tube in well D4 of the reagent tube rack.

steps.title: Set Up Deck Labware
steps.instruction: Arrange the required labware on the OT-2 deck slots.

substeps.instruction: Place the reagent tube rack in deck slot 7.
Place a full, sterile Opentrons 20 µL filter tip rack in deck slot 3.
Place an empty, sterile NEST 96 deep well plate in deck slot 1.

steps.title: Run the Protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the appropriate protocol script on the OT-2 based on the number of samples.

steps.title: Collect Output
steps.instruction: Retrieve the NEST 96 deep well plate from deck slot 1.

substeps.instruction: Verify the plate contains 24 or 48 wells of 8 µL Proteinase K + internal extraction control RNA mix.
Confirm that only odd-numbered columns (1, 3, 5, ...) are used and even-numbered columns are skipped.
